title: Launch "What Changed" tasting sessions and audience-sliced changelog playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: produce a repeatable, audience-sliced release notes process plus a lightweight internal rehearsal ("tasting") cadence so stakeholders sign off on both internal and customer-facing changelogs. Deliverables: 1) Tiered customer changelog slices (Developer, Platform Admin, Enterprise Ops) 2) Internal developer brief + exec one-pager 3) Redaction checklist and legal handoff 4) Playbook for release tasting sessions and a signoff matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Three audience-specific changelog slices drafted and approved: Developer, Platform Admin, Enterprise Ops
Internal brief + exec one-pager created and reviewed by Eng, Design, Sales and Legal
Tasting session run-through completed with notes and action items documented
Redaction checklist completed and applied to customer-facing artifacts
Signoff matrix populated with approvers and fallbacks; at least one canary reviewer assigned for each audience
notes: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with ENG/Design/Legal/Sales. Agreed on audience slices and required artifact types.
2025-02-14: Drafted Developer and Platform Admin slices; linked to draft in Drive.
2025-02-16: Legal requested clause-level redaction for one Enterprise Ops item (KMS integration). Added to redaction checklist.
2025-02-18: Design delivered compact exec one-pager mockup in Figma; Eng requested minor wording changes around SLA metrics.
2025-02-20: First tasting session scheduled for 2025-02-21. Assigned reviewers from Sales and Customer Success as canary reviewers.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Legal redaction delays could push customer-facing publish. Mitigation: ship internal brief first and embargo public notes until redaction complete.
Risk: Last-minute product changes (runtime flags) may affect wording. Mitigation: include version tag in changelog and a rapid-update path via docs PR process.
Risk: Conflicting messages across audiences. Mitigation: strict single-source-of-truth in Drive draft; designate single writer for final copy.
next_steps: 2025-02-21: Run tasting session (internal) with Sales and CS canary reviewers; capture feedback in Drive.
Post-tasting (within 48h): Apply edits, run legal redaction pass, and move customer-facing drafts to staging docs site.
Finalize signoff matrix and publish internal release brief to all orgs before customer changelog publish window.
